title: Trump signs scaled-back AI security order with voluntary 30-day pre-release access
summary: Trump signed 'Promoting Advanced AI Innovation and Security', directing Treasury, NSA and CISA to build a classified benchmark and a voluntary framework for government access to frontier models up to 30 days before release; it explicitly creates no licensing.
reason: New (voluntary) government evaluation regime for frontier models.

title: Microsoft launches in-house MAI models to cut reliance on OpenAI
summary: At Build, Microsoft unveiled MAI-Thinking-1 and MAI-Code-1-Flash among seven in-house models, and the Scout always-on Microsoft 365 agent.
reason: New competing frontier-adjacent models reduce single-partner dependence; new autonomous agent product.

title: Anthropic expands Project Glasswing to power, water and healthcare operators
summary: Anthropic extended Mythos-based vulnerability hunting to critical-infrastructure partners whose systems affect over 100M people.
reason: Defensive AI cyber use in critical infrastructure.

title: Singapore PDPC consults on personal data use in generative AI
summary: Singapore's privacy regulator launched a consultation on advisory guidelines for personal data across GenAI development and deployment.
